objective.text: Test event payload contents rather than asserting only the event class was dispatched.

difficulty.rationale: Catch an incorrect event field even when the expected event class is dispatched.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A regression dispatches OrderPlaced for order 8 when the action created order 7. Event::assertDispatched(OrderPlaced::class) still passes. Which assertion targets the missing requirement?

options.rationale: Listener registration does not verify the payload emitted by the action.
